sectors.trend: Sharp sell-off driven by iron ore weakness and rising bond yields; copper and gold-silver exploration showing relative strength
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX under pressure from iron ore spread; Flagship copper stake and Kuniko/Gateway WA gold-silver names offer diversification

sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from yield curve shifts; private credit exposure a new risk vector

sectors.trend: Oil near $US100 triggers TACO dynamics; gas reservation policy shift; AI data centres straining power supply

sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure; Stan's $800m EPL deal supports media/entertainment

sectors.implications: ASX-listed data centre and power infrastructure names benefit; Critical Resources battery tech validates energy storage thesis

risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour domestic gas/LNG plays over oil importers

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weightings; rotate into gold-silver and copper

risk_assessment.mitigation: Review bank credit exposure; monitor ASX-listed lenders' loan books

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA policy uncertainty from rental inflation vs. growth
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain duration flexibility; watch RBA statements for rate-cut signalling

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AUD depreciation shock from commodity and yield divergence
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge USD exposures; monitor AUD/USD and iron ore correlation

risk_assessment.risk_factor: NSW power adequacy and energy transition disruption
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour integrated energy and data centre infrastructure names

defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore trouble spreading; Chinese inflation may signal demand deceleration

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1-3 months as oil near $100, iron ore weakness, and private credit concerns dominate. RBA policy uncertainty and AUD depreciation add volatility. Selective opportunities in gold-silver, gas, and M&A catalysts.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if oil normalises and iron ore stabilises. AI data centre energy demand and gas policy reform create structural tailwinds for energy and infrastructure. Housing bifurcation continues; RBA likely to cut if growth softens.
